description: Average the customer counts over every employee, with employees who have no customers counted as zero.

a.request: Counting, for every employee, the customers whose `SupportRepId` is that employee (zero for employees with none), what is the average number of customers per employee? Don't round.
a.sql: SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_customers_per_employee FROM (SELECT e.EmployeeId, COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS cnt FROM Employee e LEFT JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId);

c.request: On average, how many customers does each support rep look after? Don't round. Average the customer counts over every employee, with employees who have no customers counted as zero.
c.sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT e.EmployeeId) AS AvgCustomersPerSupportRep FROM Employee e LEFT JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId

d.request: Average number of customers per employee, counting employees with no customers as zero: each employee's count of Customer rows where SupportRepId = EmployeeId (LEFT JOIN from Employee, zero for unmatched), then the average over all Employee rows, unrounded.
d.sql: SELECT AVG(e.cust_count) AS avg_customers_per_employee FROM (SELECT Employee.EmployeeId, COUNT(Customer.CustomerId) AS cust_count FROM Employee LEFT JOIN Customer ON Customer.SupportRepId = Employee.EmployeeId GROUP BY Employee.EmployeeId) AS e;

b.request: Average number of customers per employee, counting employees with no customers as zero (the mean of per-employee customer counts over all Employee rows, where each count is the number of Customer rows whose SupportRepId matches that employee).
b.sql: SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_customers_per_employee FROM (SELECT e.EmployeeId, COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS cnt FROM Employee e LEFT JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId) AS per_employee;
b.raw: Average number of customers per employee, counting employees with no customers as zero (the mean of per-employee customer counts over all Employee rows, where each count is the number of Customer rows whose SupportRepId matches that employee).
